notes: Known defect (High): Supabase still issues the recovery link in the legacy implicit-flow format (#access_token=...&type=recovery in the URL fragment) instead of the query-param token_hash format the /auth/recovery route expects. After submitting the new password, the page stays on /reset-password/update with the token still in the URL fragment instead of redirecting to /reset-password/success. Fix: switch the Supabase Auth email template to the PKCE/token_hash recovery flow, or update /auth/recovery to also handle the implicit-flow hash fragment.
